originalDiagnostic.scoredFailureReason: The model generated code that appears to address prefetching but fundamentally misunderstands how `prefetch()` works in Next.js. The test explicitly states that although the code structure is correct (title/description above Suspense, `prefetch()` call before related products), the static prerender still includes the related products in the shell. The `prefetch()` function only defers runtime work, not what gets included in static output. To pass the test, the related products must be excluded from the statically prerendered shell.
